template: Tenant Protection Act just cause eviction requirement (Civil Code 1946.2) applies to this address. Source: Cal. Civ. Code § 1946.2 (as amended by Stats. 2025, Ch. 203 (AB 1529)); as of 2027-07-02. Not legal advice.
rewrite: At this address, California's Tenant Protection Act "just cause" eviction rule applies, so a landlord needs a reason allowed by law to evict a tenant. Source: Cal. Civ. Code § 1946.2 (as amended by Stats. 2025, Ch. 203 (AB 1529)), as of 2027-07-02. Not legal advice.
